description: This file defines the LeaveDuration class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, representing various leave durations such as full day, half day, or specific times, including validation and utility methods.

classes.name: LeaveDuration
classes.description: Represents different types of leave durations with associated validation and utility methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeaveDuration instance with specified type and optional from/to times.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the leave duration type with validation.

methods.name: getFromTime
methods.description: Retrieves the start time when duration is specified by time.

methods.name: setFromTime
methods.description: Sets the start time for specify_time duration.

methods.name: getToTime
methods.description: Retrieves the end time when duration is specified by time.

methods.name: setToTime
methods.description: Sets the end time with validation that it is after fromTime.

methods.name: isTypeFullDay
methods.description: Checks if the duration is a full day.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if the duration is half day (morning or afternoon).

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayMorning
methods.description: Checks if the duration is half day morning.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayAfternoon
methods.description: Checks if the duration is half day afternoon.

methods.name: isTypeSpecifyTime
methods.description: Checks if the duration is specified by exact times.
